title: Billing
description: One monthly subscription for your organization. Every feature is included.
trialDescription: Your first 7 days include up to 10 prompts. The selected monthly allowance begins after the trial.
awaitingConfirmation: Your payment or subscription change is being confirmed. This page will update when it is ready.
resolvePayment: Your subscription needs attention. Open billing management to restore access.
pending: {quantity} prompts scheduled for the next billing cycle.
rangeDescription: Stopped prompts do not count. Taxes are included.
priceUnavailable: Prices are unavailable. Please try again.
taxNote: Taxes are included. Changes during a billing cycle can create prorated charges.
confirmationDelayed: Confirmation is taking longer than expected. Refresh the status or open billing management to check your payment.
cancellationScheduled: Cancellation is scheduled. Access continues until the end of your current period. Open billing management to resume your subscription.
trialChangeNotice: Changes apply after your trial. Your trial end date and {limit}-prompt allowance stay the same.

startPlanExpired: The payment expired and your trial continues. Start your plan to try again.

effective.current: Your current allowance has been kept.
effective.trial_end: Your selected allowance will start when your trial ends.
effective.next_cycle: The new allowance will start with your next billing cycle.

trialIncludes: Your trial includes up to 10 prompts. Your {quantity} prompts start when it ends.
trialTerms: Add a card to start. Cancel anytime. Taxes are included.
